title: Morning Brief — Monday, 9 November 2026
description: Scrutiny grows over public funding sent with Australia's COP31 delegation to Antalya, Queensland's Australian of the Year nominees are confirmed ahead of next week's ceremony, and the Gold Coast's Pan Pacific Masters Games lawn bowls competition continues at Broadbeach. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
